frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The bringing (or coming) of multiple distinct entities into a single collected whole - aggregation/assembly-into-one, and its result/state (a gathering, host, accumulation, junction, or the totalizing 'all-as-one'). The root supplies togetherness/aggregation only; it does not itself supply purpose, valency, agentivity, or moral colour.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The bringing (or coming) of multiple distinct entities into a single collected whole - aggregation/assembly-into-one, and its result/state (a gathering, host, accumulation, junction, or the totalizing 'all-as-one'). The root supplies togetherness/aggregation only; it does not itself supply purpose, valency, agentivity, or moral colour.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 129 occurrences one nucleus recurs: many things brought into one collection. It generates the concrete verbs (gather people, wealth, bones, two seas' junction, a scheme), the reflexive 'assemble', the nouns (host, junction, Day of Gathering, the Gatherer), and - grammaticalized - the totalizer jamiʿ ('all together') and the emphatic ajmaʿin ('every last one'). This 'collection-into-one' account is narrower and strictly more generative than 'totality', because 'totality' cannot produce 'gather his bones' or 'the junction of the two seas', whereas 'collection' produces both the verbs and the quantifier. The root's Quran-internal contrastive field is decisive: it stands against shatta / ashtat / tafarraqu / thubat (scattered/dispersed/sub-groups). Two coherent departures keep the judgment honest: Form IV ajmaʿa lexicalizes to 'firmly resolve upon a course' (governing amr / an-clause, in plotting frames), and jamiʿ/ajmaʿin (~61% of tokens) are grammaticalized totalizers with the gathering-act bleached.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: jmE does NOT entail: (1) inner unity/accord - 59:14:16:1 tahsabuhum jamiʿan wa-qulubuhum shatta, and 8:63:9:1 contrasts jmE with alf (uniting hearts, God's act only); (2) mere plurality/muchness - that is kathir, and 28:78:23:1 akthar jamʿan quantifies the collection by 'more'; (3) permanence/invincibility - 54:45:2:2 sa-yuhzamu l-jamʿu, 10:28:3:1 gathered then fazayyalna baynahum; (4) ordered arrangement - 20:64 pairs jmE with a separate saff (ranks); (5) creation - 42:29:13:1 lists khalq and jamʿ as distinct acts; (6) the bare distributive 'each/every' - that is kull, distinguished at 15:30:4:1 / 38:73:4:1 kulluhum ajmaʿun. The root fixes no voice/agentivity of its own (Form VIII self-assemble vs Form I gather-of).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 12:15:4:2 wa-ajmaʿu an yajʿaluhu: Form IV governs a purposive an-clause (a decided action), not a set of co-located entities; Form I in this packet never takes an an-clause, so Form IV carries a distinct argument structure and a specialized 'settle/firmly resolve upon a course' sense.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That the root's core IS 'totality/universal quantifier (all)', tempting because jamiʿ (53) + ajmaʿin (26) = 79/129 (~61%) gloss as 'all'. Rejected as the core because (a) the ~29 verbal/concrete occurrences never totalize - they concretely gather (75:3:4:1 bones, 26:38:1:2 sorcerers, 18:60:9:1 junction, 17:88:3:1 come-together) and a 'totality' core cannot generate them; (b) even the quantifier keeps the gathering content, being pointedly set against ashtatan/shatta/tafarraqu/thubat, i.e. 'all-TOGETHER' not bare 'each' - the genuinely bare universal is kull, and kulluhum ajmaʿun stacks both. A secondary competitor - full unbridging into separate homonymous classes (aggregate vs bare quantifier vs Form IV 'resolve') - is rejected because the antonymy binds the quantifier to the nucleus and the shared object kayd (20:60 Form I vs 20:64 Form IV) binds Form IV to it; the departures are lexicalized offshoots, not unbridged classes.

Rejected as the core because (a) the ~29 verbal/concrete occurrences never totalize - they concretely gather (75:3:4:1 bones, 26:38:1:2 sorcerers, 18:60:9:1 junction, 17:88:3:1 come-together) and a 'totality' core cannot generate them; (b) even the quantifier keeps the gathering content, being pointedly set against ashtatan/shatta/tafarraqu/thubat, i.e. 'all-TOGETHER' not bare 'each' - the genuinely bare universal is kull, and kulluhum ajmaʿun stacks both. A secondary competitor - full unbridging into separate homonymous classes (aggregate vs bare quantifier vs Form IV 'resolve') - is rejected because the antonymy binds the quantifier to the nucleus and the shared object kayd (20:60 Form I vs 20:64 Form IV) binds Form IV to it; the departures are lexicalized offshoots, not unbridged classes.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge: one generative nucleus (aggregation/collection-into-one) realized through a normal derivational family, adversarially clean across ~120-125/129 occurrences, fenced by robust Quran-internal negative boundaries (59:14 jmE vs shatta; 8:63 jmE vs alf; 54:45 breakable host; 3:103 jmE vs tafarruq). This broad, distinctive, boundary-clean evidence would push toward STRONG, but the contract caps it: a coherent, morphologically-marked resistant lexicalized sub-class exists - Form IV ajmaʿa 'firmly resolve upon a course' (4 occ., amr / an-clause government, plotting frames), whose reduction to the nucleus is plausible but not Quran-internally forced. A second lexicalized layer - the grammaticalized totalizer jamiʿ/ajmaʿin with bleached gathering-act - reinforces that no single uniform gloss holds across every token. Hence MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE / DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY: one nucleus with real derivational and grammaticalized offshoots, not multiple unbridged classes and not a universal generalization.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I jamaʿa/yajmaʿu (incl. passive jumiʿa): the active bringing of multiple distinct entities into one collection - gather/assemble/amass/consolidate; object varies (people for the reckoning, wealth, scattered bones, two celestial bodies, two parties for judgment, a scheme) but the operation is constant aggregation-into-one.
clusters.classification_rationale: Concrete transitive gathering across heterogeneous objects; a pure 'totality' account cannot generate 75:3:4:1 najmaʿa ʿizamahu (re-collecting scattered bones) or 26:38:1:2 fajumiʿa l-saharatu. Object-domain overlaps Form IV (kayd, 20:60:3:2 vs 20:64:1:2), anchoring the family.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 75:3:4:1 bones; 26:38:1:2 sorcerers gathered; 18:99:10:2 fajamaʿnahum; 34:26:2:1 / 42:15:31:1 yajmaʿu baynana (two parties for judgment); 4:23:43:1 tajmaʿu bayna l-ukhtayn; 104:2:2:1 jamaʿa malan; 20:60:3:2 jamaʿa kaydahu.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form VIII ijtamaʿa and participle mujtamiʿun: the reflexive/reciprocal coming-together - the same aggregation nucleus with intransitive valency (entities assemble themselves).
clusters.classification_rationale: Clean valency alternation of the nucleus: Form I 'gather X' vs Form VIII 'X gather themselves'. Orientation/agentivity is fixed by the derived form, not by the root.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 17:88:3:1 la-ini jtamaʿati l-insu wal-jinnu; 22:73:17:1 wa-lawi jtamaʿu lahu; 26:39:5:1 hal antum mujtamiʿun.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form IV ajmaʿa (+ amr / kayd / an-clause): a coherent, derivationally-marked lexicalized specialization meaning 'settle upon / firmly and collectively resolve (a course, a scheme)', shifted off pure physical aggregation into the decision-domain.
clusters.classification_rationale: All four tokens select an abstract decision-object or a purposive an-clause and cluster in makr/kayd (plotting) frames - a complementation pattern Form I never shows. Reduction to the aggregation nucleus (scattered wills -> consensus) is plausible and partly bridged by the kayd pair (20:60 vs 20:64), but is an inferred extension, NOT Quran-internally forced. Per contract a coherent resistant lexicalized sub-class caps strength at MODERATE / scope at REPRESENTATIVE.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 12:15:4:2 an-clause complement; 12:102:11:1 ajmaʿu amrahum wa-hum yamkurun; 10:71:20:2 fa-ajmiʿu amrakum; 20:64:1:2 fa-ajmiʿu kaydakum (bridged to 20:60:3:2 Form I jamaʿa kaydahu).

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Concrete/verbal-noun nominals of the nucleus: jamʿ (the collecting, or its product - a massed host/army, accumulation, the Day of Gathering), jamʿan (two gathered hosts), majmaʿ (the junction-locus where two bodies meet), majmuʿ (the patient-gathered), jamiʿ-participle (the Gatherer / an assembling affair).
clusters.classification_rationale: All realize the aggregation nucleus as act, product, locus, patient, or agent. A jamʿ is a breakable host (54:45:2:2 sa-yuhzamu l-jamʿu), fixing the negative boundary that gathering entails no permanence. majmaʿ al-bahrayn (18:60) is the junction of two - 'totality' cannot generate a junction-locus.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 54:45:2:2 routed host; 3:155:7:2 / 8:41:28:2 iltaqa l-jamʿan; 18:60:9:1 majmaʿ al-bahrayn; 11:103:11:1 majmuʿ; 3:9:3:1 jamiʿu l-nas; 75:17:3:1 jamʿahu (collection of the Qurʾan); 42:7:13:2 yawma l-jamʿ.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: jamiʿ (adverbial jamiʿan / predicate jamiʿ): grammaticalized collectivizer/totalizer - '(all) together as one body' for a plurality, 'the whole/entirety' for a singular abstract, and 'a united company/host' predicatively. The gathering-act is largely bleached but the 'as-one-against-scatter' content survives.
clusters.classification_rationale: Bridged to the nucleus by decisive Quran-internal antonymy: jamiʿan is repeatedly opposed to ashtatan (24:61:55:1), shatta (59:14:16:1), and tafarraqu (3:103:4:1) - antonymy only motivated if it still means 'together/as-one', not a bare universal (that is kull). The singular-abstract cases stretch but do not break the bridge ('the whole of X' = all parts-as-one, still against shatat).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 24:61:55:1 jamiʿan aw ashtatan; 3:103:4:1 jamiʿan wa-la tafarraqu; 4:71:10:1 thubatin aw... jamiʿan; predicate 54:44:4:1 nahnu jamiʿun muntasir; 26:56:2:2 inna la-jamiʿun hadhirun.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: ajmaʿin / ajmaʿun: grammaticalized corroborative universal ('all, every last one, without exception'), always a tawkid trailing a noun/pronoun.
clusters.classification_rationale: The gathering content is bleached to an emphatic quantifier, yet distinct from the distributive kull: 15:30:4:1 / 38:73:4:1 kulluhum ajmaʿun stacks both, showing ajmaʿ adds 'totality-as-one-collected-body' on top of kull's distribution - the nucleus survives as the collective layer.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 15:30:4:1 / 38:73:4:1 kulluhum ajmaʿun; 11:119:15:1 mina l-jinnati wal-nasi ajmaʿin; 43:55:6:1 aghraqnahum ajmaʿin; 2:161:13:1.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: al-jumuʿah: fully lexicalized calendrical proper noun, 'the day of congregation/assembly' - transparent to the nucleus but frozen as a name.
clusters.classification_rationale: Single token; a fixed name, not a productive compositional use. Transparent (day of assembly) so it does not resist, but its lexicalization is noted as structural atypicality.

reconciliation.rationale: The kayd pair cuts both ways: it shows continuity of object-domain but the amr / an-clause tokens (12:15, 12:102, 10:71) do not reduce; Form IV consistently carries a firm-resolve decision-sense with complementation Form I lacks, so the whole Form IV set is graded RESISTANT rather than forcing the bridge.

Bridged: 'the whole of X' = all parts/instances of X taken as one, still standing against shatat; it stretches but does not break the aggregation nucleus, so it is a boundary case within jamiʿ, not final resistance.

adversarial_verification.notes: The aggregation nucleus is broad, distinctive, and boundary-clean for ~120/129 occurrences, but a coherent morphologically-marked resistant sub-class (Form IV, recorded in failing_occurrences) remains bridged-only-by-inference; per contract this is NOT_RUN with resistance recorded, not PASSED (which requires failing_occurrences=[]) and not FAILED (the core is not refuted).

occurrence_dispositions.note: Concrete transitive gathering across heterogeneous objects; a pure 'totality' account cannot generate 75:3:4:1 najmaʿa ʿizamahu (re-collecting scattered bones) or 26:38:1:2 fajumiʿa l-saharatu. Object-domain overlaps Form IV (kayd, 20:60:3:2 vs 20:64:1:2), anchoring the family.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I jamaʿa/yajmaʿu (incl. passive jumiʿa): the active bringing of multiple distinct entities into one collection - gather/assemble/amass/consolidate; object varies (people for the reckoning, wealth, scattered bones, two celestial bodies, two parties for judgment, a scheme) but the operation is constant aggregation-into-one.

resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: The kayd pair cuts both ways: it shows continuity of object-domain but the amr / an-clause tokens (12:15, 12:102, 10:71) do not reduce; Form IV consistently carries a firm-resolve decision-sense with complementation Form I lacks, so the whole Form IV set is graded RESISTANT rather than forcing the bridge.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A constructive, B derivational-family, C adversarial) converged on the same nucleus, the same Form IV resistance, and the same MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE grade.
candidate_root_contribution: The bringing (or coming) of multiple distinct entities into a single collected whole - aggregation/assembly-into-one, and its result/state (a gathering, host, accumulation, junction, or the totalizing 'all-as-one'). The root supplies togetherness/aggregation only; it does not itself supply purpose, valency, agentivity, or moral colour.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 129 occurrences read in full across 12 surface classes; the nucleus is read bottom-up from concrete verbs (75:3:4:1 bones, 18:60:9:1 junction, 26:38:1:2 sorcerers) outward to nouns and quantifiers.
layer_attribution.derivation: Form I gather-of / passive be-gathered / Form VIII self-assemble are valency-and-voice alternations of one nucleus; Form IV ajmaʿa is a derivational specialization ('firmly resolve') marked by amr / an-clause complementation.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: jamiʿ and ajmaʿin/ajmaʿun are grammaticalized quantifiers (totalizer / emphatic universal) with the gathering-act bleached; al-jumuʿah is a lexicalized proper noun; these are the REPRESENTATIVE-capping lexicalized offshoots.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Moral colour (hoarding at 104:2, mercy at 39:53, battle at 8:41, prohibition at 4:23) and purpose come from context, not the root; narrative/eschatological 'Day of Gathering' framing is contextual and must NOT be read into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary CONSISTENT for 20:64 (kayd bridge) was reconciled to RESISTANT with the rest of Form IV; preliminary RESISTANT for singular-abstract jamiʿan (13:42) was reconciled to CONSISTENT as a bridged boundary case.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The Form IV 'resolve' sub-class (12:15:4:2, 12:102:11:1, 10:71:20:2, 20:64:1:2) remains bridged-by-inference only; its non-forced reduction is the standing resistance that caps the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_cases.reason: Form IV governs a purposive an-clause (decided action), not co-located entities; distinct argument structure marks a lexicalized 'resolve/settle upon a course' sense.

evidence_basis.statement: 12:15:4:2 wa-ajmaʿu an yajʿaluhu: Form IV governs a purposive an-clause (a decided action), not a set of co-located entities; Form I in this packet never takes an an-clause, so Form IV carries a distinct argument structure and a specialized 'settle/firmly resolve upon a course' sense.

hard_cases.reason: Form IV selects abstract decision-object amr in a plotting frame; firm collective resolve, not physical aggregation.

evidence_basis.statement: 10:71:20:2 / 12:102:11:1 fa-ajmiʿu amrakum / ajmaʿu amrahum: Form IV selects an abstract decision-object (amr) inside a plotting frame, denoting collective firm resolve rather than physical aggregation of countable units.

evidence_basis.statement: 20:64:1:2 fa-ajmiʿu kaydakum: bridged to the nucleus by the near-minimal pair with Form I 20:60:3:2 jamaʿa kaydahu (shared object kayd), yet Form IV overlays 'consolidate into a settled collective resolve' - a plausible but not Quran-internally forced reduction.

evidence_basis.statement: 59:14:16:1 tahsabuhum jamiʿan wa-qulubuhum shatta: outward jamʿ is explicitly divorced from unity of hearts, fixing the negative boundary that the root denotes spatial/set togetherness, not accord (inner joining is root alf, 8:63:9:1).

hard_cases.reason: Fully lexicalized calendrical proper noun; transparent to the nucleus but a frozen name, not compositional.

evidence_basis.statement: 62:9:9:2 yawmi l-jumuʿah: a fully lexicalized calendrical proper noun ('day of congregation'); transparent to the nucleus but a frozen name, not a productive compositional use.

hard_cases.reason: Grammaticalized corroborative ajmaʿun stacked on distributive kull; gathering-act bleached to emphatic universal.

evidence_basis.statement: 15:30:4:1 / 38:73:4:1 kulluhum ajmaʿun: ajmaʿin/ajmaʿun is a grammaticalized corroborative universal stacked on distributive kull, showing the 'gathering-act' content is bleached to 'every one, without exception' while still adding 'as-one-collected-body'.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The Form IV sub-class (4 occ.) is genuinely resistant (RESISTANT_SEAM, in counterevidence_refs); the singular-abstract jamiʿan, the 59:14 boundary, the al-jumuʿah proper noun, and the grammaticalized ajmaʿun are boundary/atypical hard cases that are bridged (ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY / STRUCTURAL_ATYPICALITY), not final resistance. Every statement is anchored in occurrence/cluster evidence and duplicated in overrides or the strongest_counterexample.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: The Form IV ajmaʿa tokens (12:15:4:2, 12:102:11:1, 10:71:20:2, 20:64:1:2) constitute a separate lexeme 'to resolve/decide' with no Quran-internal bridge to the aggregation nucleus, which would force an UNRESOLVED multi-class partition rather than a bridged DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY.
rejection_condition.search_location: All four V(IV) occurrences and their complements (amr, kayd, an-clause), compared against every Form I object (mal, ʿizam, nas, shams+qamar, kayd) - especially the near-minimal pair 20:60:3:2 (Form I jamaʿa kaydahu) vs 20:64:1:2 (Form IV ajmiʿu kaydakum).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test whether the shared object kayd across Forms I and IV licenses a compositional 'bring the elements of the scheme into one' reading of Form IV; if the amr / an-clause tokens cannot be paraphrased as aggregation-into-one without importing a non-Quranic 'decide' primitive, the bridge fails.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Distinguish root-borne meaning from Form-IV morphosemantics and from context: exclude the plotting/makr context as the source of 'resolve'; check kull vs ajmaʿ (15:30/38:73) so the totalizer is not mistaken for the verbal sense; hold jamiʿ antonymy (shatta/ashtat/tafarraqu) constant as the nucleus-diagnostic.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the Form IV bridge is refuted, downgrade research_state to UNRESOLVED with claim_scope_kind=UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY and split ajmaʿa off as an unbridged lexicalized class; if instead the bridge holds cleanly AND the totalizer is shown non-lexicalized, the resistant sub-class dissolves and the grade could rise toward STRONG.

reopen_conditions: Reopen if a Form I (base-verb) occurrence is found governing an an-clause or an abstract amr/kayd 'resolve' object like the Form IV tokens (12:15:4:2, 12:102:11:1), which would collapse the Form IV specialization back into the nucleus and license raising the grade toward STRONG.

Reopen if any jamiʿan/ajmaʿin occurrence is found where the totalizer is NOT paraphrasable as 'together/as-one' and is used interchangeably with bare distributive kull (contrast 15:30:4:1 kulluhum ajmaʿun), which would sever the totalizer from the aggregation nucleus and push toward an UNRESOLVED multi-class partition.
Reopen if a new occurrence shows jmE denoting inner accord/harmony directly (not merely spatial co-location), which would overturn the 59:14:16:1 / 8:63:9:1 jmE-vs-alf negative boundary.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The aggregation nucleus is broad, distinctive, and boundary-clean for ~120/129 occurrences, but a coherent morphologically-marked resistant sub-class (Form IV, recorded in failing_occurrences) remains bridged-only-by-inference; per contract this is NOT_RUN with resistance recorded, not PASSED (which requires failing_occurrences=[]) and not FAILED (the core is not refuted).
